title: Methodology Card schema + Sources-&-limits + non-partisan/"not advice" template
context: Every open-data-explainers module computes derived metrics (counts, rates, access scores, category averages). A Methodology Card standardises how each module records what was computed, from which inputs, with what parameters, and what limits apply — so reviewers, reusers, and the public can audit it. Without a canonical schema, reviewers cannot compare across modules and statistical errors go undetected. The Sources-&-limits panel and non-partisan/'not advice' template ensure civic explainers are framed correctly.
objective: Define the canonical Methodology Card schema and the standard Sources-&-limits panel + non-partisan/'not advice' notice template that every explainer module must include.
acceptanceCriteria: Canonical Methodology Card schema defined: inputs, source snapshot ref, transforms, parameters, thresholds, vintage, known limits, and an explicit 'does NOT claim' list (no causation, no ranking-as-advice, no prediction).
Standard Sources-&-limits panel template and civic non-partisan / 'not advice' notice template defined and ready to embed in any explainer.
Schema is machine-readable (JSON) and also renderable as human-readable Markdown so both automated tools and human reviewers can use it.
Reviewed and approved by the named Methodology+Stats reviewer (reviewers-001).
resources: PLAN.md — Solution approach & architecture section (Methodology Card)
PLAN.md — Quality, review & risk gates section
output: A committed Methodology Card schema (methodology-card-schema.json or equivalent) plus a Sources-&-limits + non-partisan notice template document (e.g. methodology-card-template.md), ready for use by every downstream explainer task.
